packageRules.description: Libraries: minor and patch updates are merged without review once the tests pass, and are then released by .github/workflows/release.yml. They are collected into one pull request per week (the AWS SDK alone is released almost every day), and a version is only taken after it has been public for 3 days. Renovate merges the pull request itself (platformAutomerge off), because GitHub's own auto-merge does not wait for the tests unless the branch protection requires them.
The Java version is chosen in build.gradle.kts (jvmToolchain), which Renovate cannot update: do not bump the JDK of the CI jobs to a new major version on its own.
